versions.changelog: Add AI visibility gate enforcement, settings toggle for AI controls, updated docs

- Minor update to documentation in SKILL.md.
- Revised the "Anti-template rule" section to use more accessible example language ("Understood... Goal... Action... Result...") instead of the German version.
- No functional or code changes—documentation only.

- Added homepage and metadata fields to SKILL.md for better documentation and integration.
- Metadata now specifies category, tags, and required environment variables.
- Included OpenClaw compatibility details under metadata.
- No workflow or logic changes; all updates are documentation and metadata enhancements.

Todokan Review Loop v1.0.0

- Initial release of autonomous review-loop workflow for Todokan task and thought boards.
- Processes tasks in "doing": reads latest comments, replies contextually, posts progress, and moves tasks to "done" (Review).
- Implements strong thread analysis: consistently tracks user questions, answers, and ensures no unresolved question is missed.
- Enforces strict response quality, context awareness, and temporal logic for comment posting.
- Defines clear role, workflow, and safety guardrails for automated Key Account Manager (KAM) operations.
- Suitable for polling/cron-driven automation scenarios with Todokan MCP.
